name: Divya Mohan
description: Divya is a Lead Open Source Advocate at SUSE, where she contributes to the company's open source projects. She co-chairs the documentation for the Kubernetes project & also serves on its Code of Conduct Committee. Elsewhere in the open source ecosystem, she serves as the co-chair of the CHAOSS Governing Board and as a lead for the community efforts under the Bytecode Alliance.
